title: Medication reminders that confirm the dose
read: Reminder apps are judged on whether the alert fires and whether someone else can tell a dose was missed. Check how often reviews mention missed alerts and caregivers.

title: Focus timers people keep using
job: Make me want to start the next focus block
read: A crowded category where apps compete on rewards. Check whether complaints are about price and subscriptions more than the timer.

title: Subscription trackers
job: Tell me before I get charged
read: People resent paying a subscription to track subscriptions. Check for pricing complaints and for manual-entry fatigue.

title: Splitting a receipt at the table
job: Settle the bill before we leave
read: Scan accuracy and sign-up friction decide these apps. Check for complaints about accounts and scanning.

title: Voice journals
job: Help me notice how I have been feeling
read: Transcription quality and privacy are the usual worries. Check whether people ask for on-device processing.

title: Sleep tracking without the score
job: Tell me how much rest I owe myself
read: Leaders are mature and expensive. Check for paywall complaints and Apple Watch sync problems.

title: Envelope budgeting
job: Show me what is left to spend
read: Bank sync and price drive most reviews in budgeting. Check whether a manual, offline app would dodge the main complaints.

title: Water reminders
job: Get me to drink without nagging
read: Simple apps with heavy ads and upsells. Check how many low ratings are about ads.

title: Plant identification and care
job: Tell me what is wrong with this plant
read: Known for aggressive trial paywalls. Check the share of complaints about billing.

title: Warranties and expiring documents
job: Remind me before this runs out
read: A thin category with few strong apps. Check rating counts to see whether demand exists at all.
